questions.markdown: A unit-step response test conducted on a second order system yielded peak overshoot, $M_p=0.12$, and peak time $t_p=0.2\,\text{s}$. Obtain the corresponding response indices, $M_r$, $\omega_r$, $\omega_b$ for the system.

For a unity feedback control system with open loop transfer function,

$$
G(s)=\frac{10(s+2)}{s^2(s+1)}.
$$

Find the steady state error when input

$$
R(s)=\frac{3}{s}-\frac{2}{s^2}
$$

Determine the stability of a system with characteristic equation

$$
s^6+s^5-2s^4-3s^3-7s^2-4s-4=0
$$

using Routh Hurwitz criteria

Examine whether the system characterized by the system matrix

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}1&0&2\\0&2&1\\0&0&3\end{bmatrix}
$$

and the input matrix

$$
B=\begin{bmatrix}1\\-1\\1\end{bmatrix}
$$

is controllable using Kalman's method.

For the system represented by the system matrix

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}0&-1\\2&-3\end{bmatrix},
$$

determine the State Transition Matrix.

Sketch the Bode plot for a unity feedback system with

$$
\text{OLTF }G(s)H(s)=\frac{K}{s(1+0.1s)(1+s)}
$$

and determine the value of $K$ such that the gain margin is 30 dB

Show that there is a 1 dB difference between the asymptotic and the actual Bode magnitude plot at a frequency twice that of corner frequency.

$$
\text{OLTF of a system is given by }G(s)H(s)=\frac{1}{1+Ts}
$$
